data.name: Hotel Emporio Cancún optional All-Inclusive
data.address: Blvd. Kukulcán, Retorno Gucumatz Km 17, Segunda Etapa, Zona Hotelera, 77500 Cancún, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Overlooking the Caribbean Sea, this sophisticated beachfront hotel is a 3-minute walk from the Museo Maya de Cancún and 15 km from Aeropuerto Internacional de Cancún airport.
Airy, tropical-inspired rooms feature flat-screen TVs, DVD players and Wi-Fi access, as well as balconies or terraces. All have microwaves, minifridges and coffeemakers; 1-bedroom suites and 2-bedroom villas add kitchens, living areas, wall beds and ocean views.
The hotel has 2 restaurants for Italian and international fare, along with outdoor pools, a poolside bar, a fitness room and a playground. Other amenities include a self-service market and complimentary parking.
